sequence: read exact current raw object (Issue body via readRawAuthority; control comment via list+resolve+readExact for that role)
derive current raw revision/digest (authority_source_revision, authority_observed_raw_digest) from authoritative read
compare with M4-5 external authority precondition (authority_source_revision + authority_observed_raw_digest bound in PortablePlanMutationRequest / JournalRecord PREPARED)
only then external apply eligibility: if any mismatch -> STALE_AUTHORITY fail closed, no external write; else proceed to journal APPLYING persistence then at most one external attempt
adapter_must_not: use subject revision as GitHub CAS
use normalized digest as raw CAS

github_raw_revision_model.GITHUB_RAW_AUTHORITY_REVISION_SOURCE: opaque GitHub raw revision token (e.g., Issue updated_at/etag-like token as observed string) + authority_observed_raw_digest SHA-256; see raw-precondition-model.json for full rationale
github_raw_revision_model.GITHUB_RAW_AUTHORITY_DIGEST_SOURCE: SHA-256 of exact raw body bytes (observed at read time; candidate computed from exact candidate_raw_body)
github_raw_revision_model.RAW_PRECONDITION_COMPARISON_ALGORITHM: stale_if_any_mismatch (any revision or digest mismatch -> stale fail closed)

github_native_cas_capability_review.actual_github_api_conditional_write_avai: no (for Issue body mutation via REST; no documented usable If-Match/ETag CAS that the adapter could atomically guard under all transports)

mechanical_behavior_when_no_native_cas.pre_read_validation: read exact current raw authority; compare to authorized raw precondition; fail closed if stale before any write
mechanical_behavior_when_no_native_cas.external_attempt: perform at most one typed GitHub mutation (update Issue body or update comment in place) with exact candidate_raw_body/candidate_raw_digest; do not attempt second write regardless of apparent idempotency
mechanical_behavior_when_no_native_cas.readback_verification: re-read exact authoritative GitHub object (readRawAuthority / readExactComment) to obtain observed revision/digest/body; classify via three-way candidate/original/third vs OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
mechanical_behavior_when_no_native_cas.outcome_handoff: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN / CONFLICT surfaces to M4-7 journal reconciliation; no blind retry; no old lease reuse; no heuristic third-state merge

sequence: write attempt (GitHub API returns transport result / HTTP status)
re-read exact authoritative GitHub object (mandatory readback regardless of prior transport success)

compare raw result to candidate/original: observed_raw_digest == candidate_raw_digest -> candidate observed; == original (authority_observed_raw_digest at PREPARED) -> original observed (no effect); else -> third state or CONFLICT unless supporting evidence distinguishes
return typed observation (observed_raw_digest, observed_revision, raw_body, error_code, adapter_success bool) for journal/recovery handling (M4-7 consumes)
verify_after_write.unknown_handling: if timeout/connection reset/response lost/readback unavailable -> surface OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with exact observation semantics (unknown means not success, not failure, not retry permission)
